# HexPiece 3.4.2

Your notes on the Ito Ito no Mi, the Supa Supa no Mi and the Horo Horo no Mi's Astral Projection. Not tested in game yet: the build and
all tests pass, and every new animation and effect was rendered and judged in third and first person (previews, not the game).

**Ito Ito no Mi**
- **Awakening (M) showed as "H"** on the abilities panel and in the Ability Book: they read the move's M through the original mod's key
  names, where M meant its Convergence key (rebound to H long ago). The move was always on M; the panel and book now say M (and the book
  no longer calls N moves "V").
- **Goshikito (Z), redone.** Your hand goes up with five strings hanging from the fingers into the sky, then rakes them down and forward
  like a giant claw over a long strip in front of you (22 blocks), a glowing sheet left where they swept, five glowing cuts running
  along the ground and dust thrown up. Whoever you aim at is in the middle of the strip, so it no longer misses (it used to land where your
  crosshair met a block, often behind the mob).
- **Overheat (X), now held.** Hold X with one arm pointed straight ahead: red-hot strings wind themselves into a glowing knot in front
  of your fist (it grows for 2 seconds). Let go: it fires as a red-hot rope that never comes back. It explodes where it lands (the first
  body or block, or the end of its reach: 18 to 40 blocks by the charge) in a banded fire blast that burns, while its strings scatter in
  every direction and the rope falls apart, cooling.
- **String Slash (left click), new animation.** A whip of the hand instead of the borrowed sword cuts: the hand cocked by the shoulder and
  flicked out across (forehand), then the folded arm flung open (backhand).
- **Black Knight (B), a real clone.** It wears your own skin, walks with a real stride, follows you and roams around you, fights your
  foes with your own lashes, and can be struck and killed (40 health; mobs it cuts fight back). When it dies, when you press B again, or
  after 30 seconds, it bursts into strings that cut everyone around it.
- **Birdcage (N), now held.** Hold N with your arm pointed at the sky: a steady stream of strings pours up, the cage's crown rising
  higher and wider the longer you hold (8 up to 40 blocks, full in 4 seconds). Let go: the strings spread down from the crown into the
  cage. Press N again: the cage slowly closes, cutting whoever touches its strings and pulling everyone inside to the middle; when it shuts
  they take a heavy cut and bleed (the original mod's own bleeding), and the strings burst out of it.

**Supa Supa no Mi**
- **The blades showed in third person nowhere** (only on the figure in your inventory): the mod read the original's "drawn in the world"
  flag the wrong way round. Fixed: everyone sees them.
- **Every blade is much sharper:** the arm blades, finger claws, drill blades, skates and Spar Break's blades all sweep into a long
  needle point, the steel thinner toward it.

**Horo Horo no Mi, Astral Projection (C)**
- The spirit's arms are no longer held out in front: they hang and swing like a normal player's (walking, punching).
- The spirit is immortal (falling out of the world sends it back to the body) and can strike, mine and use things, and use the fruit's
  moves, but no fighting style and no Haki.
- Your body left behind can now be struck: whatever it takes, you take, and if it dies you die. Mobs that lose sight of your spirit go
  for your body.

Next: Noro Noro no Mi's Z as a held cone, and the Ito fruit's Sky Road (3.4.3); then Goof Ball and the new Dawn Whip (3.4.4).
